My first impression was that the nurses in the inpatient ward were attentive, kind, and patient. They responded quickly when I pressed the call button.

Secondly, the building was clean because it's new. Even the basic, cheapest rooms were comfortable and looked good.

Overall, the inpatient service in the ward was good and impressive.

What I didn't like was the food poisoning I experienced at night. I called the operator, but they asked a lot of questions, even though I requested an ambulance. I was too weak to speak, yet they asked for my full name and allergies, despite my urgent request for an ambulance. When we arrived at the hospital around 9 PM, there were no front desk staff. I encountered the same operator who calmly asked for my ID card and had me sign various documents. I was slumped in my wheelchair, and my mother had to push me to the restroom while I was filling out my medical history because there was no one to help me. When I returned, they continued filling out my information. I then requested to be taken to the emergency room because I was vomiting and having diarrhea, becoming dehydrated and weak. Once in the emergency room, instead of prioritizing treatment, the finance department rushed in, demanding payments and signatures. I was too weak to speak. While in the emergency room, I continued vomiting and needing to use the restroom, but it felt like I wasn't receiving proper treatment. If payment hasn't been made yet, which is unusual at other private hospitals where they wait until the treatment is complete before issuing a receipt, and in my case, even though I was too ill to speak, they still insisted on payment without rushing the treatment. I was extremely unimpressed. Only after I paid the deposit did they administer the injection and take me to the ward. However, the service from the staff and nurses after the deposit was paid was good.

On the day I was discharged, I was still in my room. I just informed the nurse that I was leaving because the doctor had given permission. The finance department immediately rushed over. I hadn't even changed my clothes, packed my things, or gotten dressed yet, and they rushed to get the cash register for me to pay. It was as if they were afraid I wouldn't pay. This was such a negative experience that I had to write a review. I usually never write reviews, but I felt the hospital focused too much on finances, resulting in a very negative experience, even though the staff and nurses were attentive and the building was nice. Unless it was an emergency, I would definitely not use their services again.

In summary, the nurses, food delivery staff, and room cleaning staff were good, but the hospital's rush to collect payment left a very negative impression.

After 20 years of wearing glasses, I finally don’t need to wear them anymore 🥹✨

Just did my Femto LASIK at Thonburi Bamrungmuang Hospital and the experience was really smooth ✨

The doctors and staff were patient, professional, and reassuring throughout the whole process. The procedure was very fast and almost painless. Recovery was also better than I expected, although I experienced quite a lot of pain and tearing about 6–7 hours after the LASIK. Thankfully, the painkillers and sleeping pills helped a lot, and my vision became clearer really quickly 👀

The hospital environment was clean, modern, and comfortable too. Grateful for the good care and experience in Bangkok 🇹🇭
The parking attendants were helpful and polite, the restrooms were very clean, and the LASIK center provided excellent care.

Yesterday I was seen here in the Ear, Nose, and Throat department. The receptionists were very kind and escorted me to the department where I would be seen later. They were very professional and treated me well. The consultation alone cost 1200 baht, and with the flu medication and ear infection treatment, the total came to 5600 baht. Luckily, my travel insurance covered it. I don't know if it's expensive or cheap, but I think it's very reasonable considering the care I received. Also, the hospital is incredibly clean and beautiful. I've never seen a hospital like it.

Thank you 🙏🏼
